ModMetaData.name: Bank of Rimica
ModMetaData.author: kanid99
ModMetaData.description:
A space bank for your colony.
Build a Rimica bank uplink and your colonists can: - Deposit silver (launched from orbital trade beacons) and earn interest. - Take out loans, delivered by drop pod. - Take debt collection contracts against defaulted settlements: send a caravan to lean on them, or destroy them to seize their assets. - Host the bank's holdings for a quadrum, half a year or a year. You pick where the bank's crate goes; a bank shuttle lands, sets it down and loads it with silver bars (10,000 silver each), then comes back to collect them at the end. The holding counts toward your wealth, draws far more raids and at least one massive Bank Heist raid (often on gauntlet ships with Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates, especially once you hold a million silver). Every bar stolen is charged to you. Get paid 1% of the holding in silver, or 5% as credit at the bank's commodity shop, which sells nearly every item in the game.
Default on a loan, or refuse to pay, and the bank seizes your savings and puts out a bounty contract on your colony. Bounty hunters keep coming, bigger each time, until you pay or are destroyed.
Requires the Odyssey DLC and Vanilla Quests Expanded - Deadlife. Safe to add to an existing save. No Harmony required.
